v26-9.candidate: David said to Abishai, “Do not humble him. For who will bring his hand against the Lord’s anointed and be acquitted?”

v26-15.candidate: David said to Abner, “Are you not a man? Who is like you in Israel? Why do you not guard your lord the king? For one of the people entered to destroy the king, your lord.

v26-18.candidate: He said, “Why does my lord pursue his servant in this way? For how have I sinned, and what wrong has been found in me?

v26-20.candidate: Now let my blood not fall to the ground opposite the Lord’s presence. For Israel’s king has come out to seek my soul, as the night-raven pursues in the mountains.”

v27-10.candidate: Achish said to David, “Whom have you all attacked today?” David said to Achish, “The south of Judea, the south of Jesmega, and the south of Kenezi.”
